_doc: Football schedule / fatigue term on the PURE rating goals centres (path (ii)): FootballForecast.centre('goals_for', side) x exp(t_side), t_side = sum_c coef[own_c] * own.indicators()[c] + sum_c coef[opp_c] * opp.indicators()[c] over schedule_features.FOOTBALL_COLUMNS (a coefficient absent = 0); t = 0 for both sides when either has no calendar coverage, and for a national-team fixture. Read by bet.sofa.schedule_term under epochs.SCHEDULE_TERM; the coefficients are the frozen, shrunk dev fit that passed the one exam (group football_result) - installed as they are, never refitted. excluded_markets: the simulator's four 0.60-floor keys keep the uncorrected p until their floor is re-measured on the corrected p (pre-registration D13 / plan item 8).

fitted_from.method: dev 2024-07-01..2025-12-31 Poisson GLM, team-season FE, shrunk tau 0.05 (pre-registration 6)
